Create a new application

Usage:
  camber app create [flags]

Flags:
      --file string     Path to the JSON file containing app definition (local path or stash://path)
  -h, --help            help for create
      --output string   output format (e.g. json)

Global Flags:
      --api-key string   API key for authentication (also set via CAMBER_API_KEY env var)

Run an application

Usage:
  camber app run [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help                help for run
      --input stringArray   Input in key=value format. Repeat for multiple inputs.
      --node-size string    Node size for the job
      --num-nodes int32     Number of nodes for the job
      --output string       output format (e.g. json)
      --with-gpu            Whether to use GPU

Global Flags:
      --api-key string   API key for authentication (also set via CAMBER_API_KEY env var)

Describe an application

Usage:
  camber app describe [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for describe
      --output string   output format (e.g. json)

Global Flags:
      --api-key string   API key for authentication (also set via CAMBER_API_KEY env var)

Stream an idempotent pod worker run until its final result

Usage:
  camber pod spawn [flags]

Flags:
      --agent-id string                Selected agent UUID
      --child-conversation-id string   Existing child conversation UUID
  -h, --help                           help for spawn
      --message string                 Worker task
      --message-stdin                  Read the worker task from stdin
      --pod-id string                  Parent pod UUID
      --request-id string              Idempotency UUID

Global Flags:
      --api-key string   API key for authentication (also set via CAMBER_API_KEY env var)
